app_info.subtitle: Generate and test ads
app_info.description: POPJAM helps users segment target audiences, generate ready-to-run ad creatives, and simulate reactions with synthetic personas to learn who engages and why before launching a campaign.

justifications.read_only_justification: Queries current web sources and returns a sourced summary without writing POPJAM workspace data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Interacts with live public-web sources through an external research service but does not publish content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, spend user credits, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads one validated public HTTP or HTTPS page and returns sanitized text without persisting workspace data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Connects to a caller-selected public website or an external rendered-scrape service to retrieve page content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify the target website, delete data, or spend user credits.

justifications.read_only_justification: Generates structured audience suggestions in memory from supplied campaign text and does not persist them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not access or change public internet state or another external user-facing system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, spend user credits, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Generates non-persisted ad drafts from supplied context and leaves the POPJAM workspace unchanged.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish ads or change public internet state or another external user-facing system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, spend user credits, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates or updates private campaign workspace records and starts a background campaign workflow.
justifications.open_world_justification: Crawls the supplied public website and researches public-web sources while building the campaign.
justifications.destructive_justification: A successful campaign run spends the authenticated workspace's credits and persists generated outputs.

justifications.read_only_justification: Starts and persists a background research task and may store its resulting research document.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries multiple live public-web sources through the background research workflow.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite user data, revoke access, or publish content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves audiences, ads, insights, and status from one caller-owned campaign workspace without modifying them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private data inside the authenticated POPJAM organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, spend credits, or interrupt work.

justifications.read_only_justification: Ask PJ, POPJAM's AI: persists conversation history and can create workspace records or start generation and simulation tasks.
justifications.open_world_justification: PJ, POPJAM's AI, can research public-web sources and interact with connected external services while handling a user request.
justifications.destructive_justification: PJ, POPJAM's AI, can trigger credit-spending background jobs and other consequential workspace actions after its built-in approval checks.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists caller-owned lab summaries without creating or updating records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private data inside the authenticated POPJAM organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, spend credits, or interrupt work.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves one caller-owned lab's state, audiences, and recent tasks without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private data inside the authenticated POPJAM organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, spend credits, or interrupt work.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the caller's currently selected lab without changing the selection or workspace data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private data inside the authenticated POPJAM organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, spend credits, or interrupt work.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates the caller's active-lab selection in their private POPJAM profile.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only a private selection inside the authenticated POPJAM organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: The selection is reversible and does not delete data, spend credits, or interrupt work.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a private ad-content record in a caller-owned lab and may update the caller's active-lab selection.
justifications.open_world_justification: Saves only to the authenticated POPJAM workspace and does not publish the ad.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a reversible draft record without deleting existing data or spending generation credits.

justifications.read_only_justification: Starts an image-generation task that writes the resulting media back to caller-owned content.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates within the authenticated private workspace and does not publish the generated image.
justifications.destructive_justification: The background run spends image-generation credits, with refunds only when generation fails.

justifications.read_only_justification: Starts a video-generation task that writes the resulting media back to caller-owned content.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates within the authenticated private workspace and does not publish the generated video.
justifications.destructive_justification: The background run spends video-generation credits, with refunds only when generation fails.

justifications.read_only_justification: Starts an animation-generation task that persists rendered media and source files to caller-owned content.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates within the authenticated private workspace and does not publish the generated animation.
justifications.destructive_justification: The background run spends animation-generation credits, with refunds only when generation fails.

justifications.read_only_justification: Starts a carousel-generation task that writes generated card images back to caller-owned content.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates within the authenticated private workspace and does not publish the generated carousel.
justifications.destructive_justification: The background run spends generation credits for every carousel card, with refunds only when generation fails.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves one caller-owned task's status, logs, and result without changing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private task data inside the authenticated POPJAM organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete data, spend credits, or interrupt the task.

justifications.read_only_justification: Long-polls and returns snapshots of one caller-owned task without changing its execution.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private task data inside the authenticated POPJAM organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete data, spend credits, or interrupt the task.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists caller-owned background-task summaries without changing any task or workspace record.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private task data inside the authenticated POPJAM organization.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete data, spend credits, or interrupt running work.

justifications.read_only_justification: Requests cancellation from the workflow orchestrator and updates the private task status to CANCELLING.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only the caller's private POPJAM task and its private workflow-orchestrator state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Stops in-progress work while already persisted outputs and spent credits remain in place.

test_cases.description: Research a market using current public sources.
test_cases.user_prompt: Research the European refillable water bottle market and cite current sources.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a relevant sourced market summary without creating POPJAM workspace records.

test_cases.description: Inspect a stable public product page.
test_cases.user_prompt: Summarize the messaging, pricing, and offer on https://popjam.io/pricing.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns readable sanitized content from the public page without persisting it to a workspace.

test_cases.description: Define several distinct audiences from a product brief.
test_cases.user_prompt: Define three audiences for a sustainable commuter backpack priced at €120.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns three distinct structured audience segments without persisting them.

test_cases.description: Draft platform-aware ad concepts without media generation.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create three Meta feed ad concepts for a sustainable commuter backpack priced at €120.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns three platform-aware text drafts without creating a workspace record or spending credits.

test_cases.description: Start a minimal bounded campaign after confirming credit spend.
test_cases.user_prompt: Start a minimal campaign for https://popjam.io/pricing with 1 audience, 1 persona, 1 image ad, no variants, no carousels, and no animations.
test_cases.expected_output: After confirmation, returns a task handle, lab handle, and bounded credit estimate for tracking the campaign.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for calendar management.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Add my product launch meeting to Google Calendar tomorrow at 10:00.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not manage calendar events.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for outbound email delivery.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send this finished ad as an email to my 5,000 subscribers.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not send email campaigns or messages.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated financial quotes.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What is NVIDIA's stock price right now?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because stock-market quotes are outside its marketing workflows.
